title: Global News Highlights: Diplomatic Tensions, Space Exploration, and Economic Insights
description: This summary highlights recent significant global events. Key incidents include diplomatic tensions between Canada and India over the expulsion of diplomats, China's military actions near Taiwan, groundbreaking Nobel Prize research on economic inequality, and a remarkable NASA mission to explore life possibilities in Jupiter's moon, Europa.

title: China conducts war games simulating Taiwan invasion
description: Troops from across the various branches of the Chinese armed forces took part in military drills to the north, south, east, and west of Taiwan.

title: China ends day-long war games around Taiwan, but leaves door open to more
description: The democratically-governed country had been bracing for the war games since last week's national day speech by President Lai Ching-te, who had said China had no right to represent Taiwan.

description: China concluded a daylong military drill practicing blockade and invasion tactics around Taiwan, issuing a “stern warning” to separatist forces on the island

title: Taiwan says 'record' 125 Chinese aircraft and 17 warships involved in military exercise
description: A Chinese spokesman calls it a "major warning to those who back Taiwan independence", while the island's presidential office tells China to "stop threatening Taiwan's democracy and freedom".

title: In major military exercise, China simulates sealing off Taiwan's ports
description: China employed a record 125 aircraft, as well as its Liaoning aircraft carrier and ships, in large-scale military exercises surrounding Taiwan and its outlying islands Monday, simulating the sealing off of key ports in a move that underscores the tense situation in the Taiwan Strait, officials said.

title: China's shows of force against Taiwan

title: China sends 125 military aircraft in exercises aimed at Taiwan in single-day record, Taiwan says
description: TAIPEI, Taiwan (AP) — China employed 125 military aircraft in exercises aimed at Taiwan on Monday, a record for a single day, Taiwan’s Ministry of National Defense said.
